title: Eliciting Weak-to-Strong Generalization with On-Policy Reverse Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08798v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weak-to-strong generalization asks whether stronger models can learn from weaker supervisors and surpass them. This question is particularly important for successive model generations and multi-domain consolidation, where repeating frontier-scale post-training from scratch can be prohibitively expensive. Yet conventional distillation treats the weak teacher as an optimization target, potentially imposing its capacity ceiling on the student. We introduce On-Policy Reverse Distillation (OPRD), which evaluates the teacher's policy shift relative to its reference policy on student rollouts and amplifies the component of the student's verifier-driven policy gradient along that direction. By rescaling only verifier-supported updates, OPRD preserves the stationary points of policy optimization while accelerating learning beyond the teacher. translated_title: 通过在线策略反向蒸馏引出弱到强泛化
translated_abstract: 弱到强泛化探讨的是更强的模型能否从较弱的监督者那里学习并超越它们。这个问题对于模型的连续代际传承和多领域整合尤为重要，因为在这些场景下，从头重复前沿规模的后训练可能代价过高。然而，传统的蒸馏方法将弱教师模型视为优化目标，可能会将其能力上限强加给学生模型。我们提出了在线策略反向蒸馏（OPRD），该方法在学生模型的滚动输出上评估教师策略相对于其参考策略的偏移，并放大学生模型由验证器驱动的策略梯度沿该方向的分量。通过仅重新缩放由验证器支持的更新，OPRD在保持策略优化驻点的同时，加速学习以超越教师模型。在连续模型迁移和多教师蒸馏中，OPRD以更...
tldr: 提出在线策略反向蒸馏（OPRD）方法，通过在学生模型滚动输出上评估教师策略偏移并放大学生验证器驱动的策略梯度分量，在保留优化驻点的同时加速学习，使学生模型超越弱教师模型，实现弱到强泛化。
en_tdlr: Proposes On-Policy Reverse Distillation (OPRD), which evaluates the teacher's policy shift on student rollouts and amplifies the verifier-driven policy gradient component, preserving optimization stationary points while accelerating learning beyond weaker teachers, thus eliciting weak-to-strong generalization.
